item.title: Brazil's Lula-Bolsonaro showdown unfolds in Trump's shadow, with the Amazon at stake
item.description: Brazil votes Sunday in a presidential election that could reshape its relationship with President Trump, return the Bolsonaro movement to power and affect the Amazon.

item.title: Republicans Pull Back in North Carolina Before Election Day
item.description: A month before the election, major GOP donors are abandoning North Carolina for other states, signaling a shift in priorities.

item.title: Democrats' Big Ambitions May Backfire in House Races
item.description: Democrats' hopes for a landslide could turn into a setback as candidates in Republican-leaning districts struggle to distance themselves from the party.

item.title: Senate Outpaces House in Congressional Work Days
item.description: Data shows the Senate is far ahead of the House in days worked, according to Ballotpedia and Congressional Record.
